description: Contact detail and dossier apply the caller's CRM record visibility before any child row or journey collaborator is read, and a denied row answers like an absent one. Run from apps/server: npx vitest run test/contacts-visibility.integration.test.ts --reporter=json --outputFile=.proof/r0-01-vitest.json against a migrated local database and REDIS_URL, then node ../../scripts/proof-admission/evaluate.mjs --manifest ../../scripts/proof-admission/manifests/contacts-visibility.json --report .proof/r0-01-vitest.json. Cases tagged NEGATIVE CONTROL fail at b1948d27; the ADMIN dossier NEGATIVE CONTROL also fails at the superseded variant 6a5c0c3f (collaborators in Promise.all beside the detail lookup). allowAdditionalCases is false so that every case in the file is binding: a later packet that adds a case to contacts-visibility.integration.test.ts (V1-08-CT-SIBLING-VISIBILITY) must add its full title here in the same change, so its write_set must include this manifest, otherwise this manifest rejects its report with KF_PROOF_UNEXPECTED_CASE. Review repair CR-1: as of R0-01 the queue entry for V1-08 does not list this manifest; the integrating session adds it to V1-08's write_set and tests_first (BUILD-QUEUE-001.json is outside this packet's write set). V1-08-CT-SIBLING-VISIBILITY (M13, PRS-M12) adds the describe 'contact-scoped sibling reads through the real guard path (V1-08)': the fourteen contact-scoped sibling reads (events, notes, journey, cross-journey, story, revenue-summary, health-metrics, relationships, network, data-quality, playbook, conversations, conversation-context, best-channel) run against the real services over a model-access recorder; a refused read answers the detail's 404, byte-identical to an absent id, reads no model beyond the guards' and the visibility gate's own (user, membership, business, contact) and creates no playbook row, while the owner and an explicit ContactShare get 200 with child rows, and a crm 'write' STAFF member without crm_reassign is refused 403 on a PATCH ownerId (regression control: R0-13c already enforced it). RED-BEFORE at 182af4b8 (tests-first commit): 6 of the 11 new cases fail (the five NEGATIVE CONTROL cases and the sibling/detail agreement; every one of the 14 routes answered 200 for the refused actor), the two positive controls, the 401 case, the fixture sanity and the PATCH regression control pass; the 30 earlier cases pass. Review repairs (V1-08 ST-1, ST-2, ST-3, CR-1) add three cases and strengthen one: relationships and network keep only the neighbours GET detail opens for the member (the network walk is redone without the hidden ones, so a contact reached only through one is dropped too), the business network likewise, and POST relationships and POST refer gate both ends; the sibling/detail agreement case, which compared status codes only, now also checks that every contact a relationships or network answer names opens on GET detail for that member (renamed, '; relationships and network name no contact GET detail does not open (review ST-1)'). The review cases check GET detail's rule through CrmStatsService.contactDetail directly, so they add no request to the detail route's per-handler rate limit. RED-BEFORE at the V1-08 head 390ec4c4: the three new cases and the strengthened agreement case fail (staffAll and ADMIN read cPrivOwner and its relationship note through cTeamOwner's relationships and network; the business network shows cPrivOwner to owned-view STAFF; POST relationships to staffAll's PRIVATE contact answers 201 to a crm write member).
